name: 11529-highqps-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 5120 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 30% by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, streaming, 250 prompt tokens (200-token shared prefix plus 50 request-specific) and exactly 200 output tokens, min = max on both, temperature 0.0, ignore_eos.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant streaming short 200-token replies to 256 concurrent users from one GPU, sharing a common prompt preamble.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Interpreter and hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml.
#
# HAZARD: VLLM_USE_V1 is not an engine argument and cannot live in this file. It defaults to 0
# on this engine, so it is carried in configs/tuned.yaml as `env:VLLM_USE_V1=1`.

# NousResearch's is the ungated mirror of the meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights; the
# Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Load-bearing: this defaults to `bool(VLLM_USE_V1)` here, i.e. ON, and the workload's prompts
# share a 200-token prefix by construction.
enable-prefix-caching: false

disable-log-requests: true

# HAZARD: unset, this resolves to 1024 when V1 is on and 256 when it is off, and a silent 256
# would cap the declared operating point exactly.
max-num-seqs: 1024

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
